Ⅰ. 오바댜 개관\n - 오바댜라는 말은 오바드 야후, 여호와를 경배하는:
Ⅰ. Obadiah Overview
 - The name Obadiah is Obad Yahu, one who worships the LORD. It prophesies the destruction of Edom
 - Edom - the descendants of Esau, twin descendants with Jacob's descendants, and yet at the drop of a hat they went to Jerusalem or Samaria and plundered.  Also, when the Israelites were in trouble, they laughed, ha ha, ha ha, and enjoyed it. I said God judges for moral problems too, right?.
 - And it says that he doesn't judge evil nations right away, one by one; he saves them all up, and when the day the LORD has set comes, they perish together.
<옵1:1> 오바댜의 묵시라 주 여호와께서 에돔에 대하여 이같이 말씀하시:
<Obad 1:1> The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
 - It means a judgment was prophesied concerning Edom, and we heard it.
<옵1:2> 여호와께서 가라사대 내가 너를 열국 중에 미약하게 하였으므로: <Obad 1:2> Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.
얘기 했었죠? 하나님께서 미약하게 하신다고 하면 미약해져 버린다고. 지금: I told you, right? When God says he'll make someone small, they become small. Today you can't find the descendants of Edom on this earth, and the same goes for Nineveh, the same for Babylon.
<옵1:3~9> 바위 틈에 거하며 높은 곳에 사는 자여 네가 중심에 이르: <Obad 1:3~9> Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground? The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee. Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the LORD.
- 바위틈 = 페트라. 요르단 남부 세일산 산록의 페트라라는 성에 깃들어: - Clefts of the rock = Petra. They lived in a city called Petra at the foot of Mount Seir in southern Jordan.
- 사방이 바위 : 천연의 요새이지만 단점이 농사 불가능 그래서 강도짓: - Rock on every side : a natural fortress, but the downside is farming was impossible, so robbery was their main business
You have to go in several km through a narrow gap like this. High cliffs on both sides. A complete natural fortress. If you just guard that entrance, nobody can get near... so they were proud.
양쪽 절벽에 자세히 보면 도랑 같은게 있어요. 저 절벽을 타고 흐르는 빗: If you look closely at the cliffs on both sides there's something like a ditch. Rainwater running down those cliffs flows along the ditch into the city inside. Really clever, isn't it?
저 입구를 보세요. 저게 건축물이 아니고 조각이에요. 바위를 깎아서 저런: Look at that entrance. That's not a building; it's a carving. They carved the rock to make an entrance like that. Enormous, isn't it? A person is this small. They carved it while coming down on ropes from up above, and the skill is amazing. This had to succeed in one go; you couldn't fix it halfway.
이런 것도 전부 조각입니다. 성경은 바위 틈에 거하며...정도로 얘기 하: All of this is carving too. The Bible only says, dwelling in the clefts of the rock... and so on; well, God works on such a big scale, but to us it's a work of art. This Edom is completely wiped out, and the reason is given from verse 10 on.
<옵1:10~14> 네가 네 형제 야곱에게 행한 포학을 인하여 수욕을 입:
<Obad 1:10~14> For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever. In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.
 - When their brother nation Israel was suffering, of course they should have helped, but instead they were glad. Because they did this they are destroyed, but that doesn't mean God sends punishment from heaven right away. But there will surely be a day when he judges.
<옵1:15> 여호와의 만국을 벌할 날이 가까왔나니 너의 행한 대로 너도: <Obad 1:15> For the day of the LORD is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
See? I told you he judges sooner or later. You reap what you sow.
Look at the very bottom line.
4. 오바댜서와 같은 내용을 다루고 있는 성경구절들\n 1) 이사야 34:
4. Bible passages that deal with the same content as Obadiah
 1) Isaiah 34
 2) Jeremiah 49:7~22
 3) Ezekiel 35:1~15
 4) Amos 1:11~12
서로 다른 지역에 사는, 서로 다른 사람이 썼는데 내용이 동일하다는 겁니: Different people, living in different places, wrote them, and the content is the same. That means someone intervened, right? Just from things like this you can tell that the original author of the Bible is God. They're prophets of the same era, so they say the same thing, and who said those words? Because God said them, they say the same thing across regions.
Now we go back again to 2 Kings 17.
아까 16장까지 보고 그 시대에 활동 했던 선지자들 쭉 보고 다시 돌아: Earlier we read up to chapter 16, went through the prophets who were active in that period, and now we go back. We paused history for a moment and went through the words of the prophets of the same era. History flows again.
